title: Behind the King
setup: The black king has run to c7, where its own knight and bishop block b8 and c8.
hint: The d-file is already sealed by your rook, so look for the check that takes the last diagonal square away.
explanation:
## The Idea

The rook on d1 covers d6 and d7, and Black's own knight and bishop block b8 and c8, leaving b6. {{Bd8#}} checks from the far end of the diagonal and covers b6 on its way. The mating square can be behind the king, not in front of it.
